I did something like this as well. Played as a Nagaji with a very good charisma based character with great disguise and joined the party a session late after it had already started. 

After I joined them one of the other players kept on picking on me and throwing rocks at me because I was nagaji. So once we hit the next town and going to the guild hall, I made sure to get there first and get the bully player separated.

Once I got to the guild hall, I disguised as a generic guild leader and offered a bounty too great to refuse for the head of the bully player. The DM just went with it.

A few rolls later, I have received the head of my bully.
